answer: Since the copper audit keeps the pair, the mismatch is rejected rather than silently down-graded. A farm cannot pad to satisfy both, because the declared depth is written down in the ferrous receipt and checked against the saffron nonce, so a padded text pays the fee and is refused anyway. An answer declaring deep analysis must run at least 205 characters, and one declaring a brief note must stay under half that, so length has to match the claim. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
